import math
import unittest

from solution import make_scalers


class MakeScalersTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_order_and_value_capture(self):
        factors = [2, -3, 0.5]
        original = factors[:]
        scalers = make_scalers(factors)
        self.assertEqual([fn(4) for fn in scalers], [8, -12, 2.0])
        self.assertEqual(factors, original)

    def test_each_callable_captures_its_own_factor(self):
        factors = [2, 3]
        scalers = make_scalers(factors)
        factors[0] = 100
        factors[1] = 200
        self.assertEqual(scalers[0](5), 10)
        self.assertEqual(scalers[1](5), 15)
        self.assertEqual(scalers[0](-1.5), -3.0)

    def test_empty_and_generator_inputs(self):
        self.assertEqual(make_scalers([]), [])
        scalers = make_scalers(value for value in [1, 4])
        self.assertEqual([fn(3) for fn in scalers], [3, 12])

    def test_invalid_factors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            make_scalers(None)
        for value in [True, False, "2", None, object()]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    make_scalers([1, value])
        for value in [math.inf, -math.inf, math.nan]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    make_scalers([value])

    def test_callable_validates_each_argument(self):
        scaler = make_scalers([2])[0]
        for value in [True, False, "3", None, object()]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    scaler(value)
        for value in [math.inf, -math.inf, math.nan]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    scaler(value)

    def test_validation_finishes_before_functions_are_returned(self):
        def factors():
            yield 2
            yield "bad"

        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            make_scalers(factors())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
